svg.text: No gears, bellows, chimney or mechanical power connection
FORMED: STEPPED BRICK RIM + GENERATED FIREBED
BUILD: 8 full bricks + AIR. FORM: low rim + interior appear.
Canonical layer order: rear row to front row
F: Foundation B: Bricks U: Input C: Controller O: Output
AIR = empty before formation; the machine generates its firebed afterward.
Solid furnace fuel only • no shaft, RPM or torque
HEAT expires after 2,400 world ticks (existing contract)
U → item input C → solid fuel & status O → hot items
Idle: cools • Heating: fuel burns • Blocked: progress pauses
No Bloom consolidation or Steel refining; the existing Kiln remains useful.
